metadata.title: PSScriptTools
metadata.description: A collection of PowerShell functions designed to enhance your own functions and scripts or to facilitate working in the console. Most of the commands should work in Windows PowerShell and PowerShell 7, even cross-platform. Any operating system limitations should be handled on a per-command basis.
